name: Orphan Matron Battlewail
summary: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, Orphan Matron Battlewail cares for children left without families by war. With Tosamina, she gives them shelter and raises young orcs.

sections.title: Caretaker of the Horde's Youth
sections.body: Orphan Matron Battlewail cares for children who have lost their kin to violence. In Orgrimmar, where war's toll reaches even the young capital, she and Tosamina shelter and nurture the next generation of the Horde. The orphanage in the Valley of Honor opens its doors to passing adventurers. During Children's Week, travelers are called upon to mentor the children.

faq.answer: Orphan Matron Battlewail is an orc woman who oversees Orgrimmar's orphanage. She shelters and raises children whose parents died in battle.

faq.q: Where can she be found in Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Battlewail and Tosamina care for the children in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, in the city's eastern reaches.

faq.q: What is her role during Children's Week?
faq.answer: During Children's Week, Battlewail sends willing champions out with an orphan to show them the wonders and heritage of the Horde.

faq.q: Who assists Battlewail at the orphanage?
faq.answer: Tosamina lives and works alongside Battlewail, helping watch over and protect the children in their care.

angles.text: For the Horde, Battlewail gives guidance and shelter to children left behind by war, helping preserve the people's future.
As an orc seeking a lasting homeland in Durotar, you can see in Battlewail's orphanage the sacrifices your people endure.
